title: Three-scenario commitment lanes for Hosted API and Model Catalog — Q2 synthesis
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Objective: Produce a defensible Q2 commitment plan that maps three demand scenarios (Conservative / Base / Surge) to commitment lanes for Hosted API capacity and model-catalog rollouts. Scope: define success criteria, OKR alignment, acceptance gates for canaries, staff/ops impact, and a contingency decision tree for swaps or throttles. Excludes detailed capacity procurement (handled by Dedicated team) but will include suggested hedges. Deliverables: 1) Scenario matrix with capacity and model-priority mappings, 2) Commitment lanes doc for PM/Eng/Infra sign-off, 3) Runbook for decision triggers and owner roster, 4) Executive one-pager for GTM and Sales enablement.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario matrix validated with two capacity/infra stakeholders and one SRE
Each model in the Top-25 hosted catalog has a mapped lane and rollback trigger
OKR owners have agreed target metrics and contingencies for each scenario
Runbook includes explicit thresholds, owners, and communication playbook for customer-impacting changes
A go/no-go checklist exists for canary windows and A/B rollout decisions
